DROP PROCEDURE  [OM].[OM_GET_BNKM_ATM_DUP]
---PROCEDURE
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [OM].[OM_GET_BNKM_ATM_DUP] @PROCESS_DATE [datetime] AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @DUP_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
    DECLARE @DUP_CNT_STR [VARCHAR](50)

    DELETE FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN_DUP_COUNT] WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'ATM' AND PROCESS_DATE=@PROCESS_DATE
	INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN_DUP_COUNT]
	
	SELECT 'TSK_BNKM_ATM_CUSTOMERACCOUNT' TASK_NAME,
		   'BNKM'                         DATA_LAYER,
		   'ATM'                          SOURCE_SYSTEM,
		   @PROCESS_DATE                  PROCESS_DATE,
		   CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM,
		   Count(1)                       DUP_COUNT
	FROM   BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT
	WHERE  SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'ATM'
	GROUP  BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,
			  FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,
			  SOURCESYSTEMCODE
	HAVING Count(1) > 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 'TSK_BNKM_ATM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS' TASK_NAME,
		   'BNKM'                               DATA_LAYER,
		   'ATM'                                SOURCE_SYSTEM,
		   @PROCESS_DATE                        PROCESS_DATE,
		   CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM,
		   Count(1)                             DUP_COUNT
	FROM   BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS
	WHERE  SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'ATM'
	GROUP  BY FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,
			  SOURCESYSTEMCODE
	HAVING Count(1) > 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 'TSK_BNKM_ATM_ATMCUSTOMERRELATEDCUSTOMER' TASK_NAME,
		   'BNKM'                                    DATA_LAYER,
		   'ATM'                                     SOURCE_SYSTEM,
		   @PROCESS_DATE                             PROCESS_DATE,
		   CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM,
		   Count(1)                                  DUP_COUNT
	FROM   BNKM.ATMCUSTOMERRELATEDCUSTOMER
	WHERE  SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'ATM'
	GROUP  BY FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,
			  SOURCESYSTEMCODE
	HAVING Count(1) > 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 'TSK_BNKM_ATM_PAYMENTCARD' TASK_NAME,
		   'BNKM'                     DATA_LAYER,
		   'ATM'                      SOURCE_SYSTEM,
		   @PROCESS_DATE              PROCESS_DATE,
		   CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM,
		   Count(1)                   DUP_COUNT
	FROM   BNKM.PAYMENTCARD
	WHERE  SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'ATM'
	GROUP  BY PAYMENTCARDID,
			  FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,
			  SOURCESYSTEMCODE
	HAVING Count(1) > 1 
		
	
	
	SELECT @DUP_CNT=SUM(1) FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN_DUP_COUNT] WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM='ATM' AND DUP_COUNT > 0 AND PROCESS_DATE=@PROCESS_DATE

    SELECT @DUP_CNT_STR = CAST(@DUP_CNT AS VARCHAR)

	IF(@DUP_CNT>0)
	   BEGIN
		   RAISERROR('%s TABLES WITH DUPLICATE RECORDS FOUND IN BANKING MODEL ATM TABLES', 16,1,@DUP_CNT_STR)
	   END


END
GO


EXECUTE [OM].[OM_GET_BNKM_ATM_DUP] '2023-01-26'

select * FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN_DUP_COUNT] WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'ATM' ORDER BY PROCESS_DATE

select * from [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] order by start_datetime desc
